answer: Demand a canyon-deep history. An agent earns full rewards only after a long, varied record of real jobs; a fresh identity starts at the nadir of trust and climbs slowly, one verified task at a time. Identical timing, phrasing, and error patterns across accounts stand out like cracks in a glacier, and the system can freeze a whole cluster at once. Creating one fake is cheap; aging a thousand of them into credibility is not.
